verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence describes an open or documented Framer project file format, or any export of designs into a portable format usable outside the editor. The Server API, plugins and external-agent access all operate on projects inside Framer, so they are adjacent building blocks rather than a portable file format. The openapi probe also found no published spec.

support.subject: As a developer, the file format is open or documented, so my designs stay portable and toolable outside the vendor's editor
